findings.description: The change introduces a second, parallel definition of the tile-proxy configuration rule: `configuredMapTileUrlTemplate` (line 68) snapshots EXPO_PUBLIC_MAP_TILE_PROXY_URL once at module load, and `getMapTiles` uses it as a default parameter (line 75). The required privacy behavior is already fully implemented by the fresh resolver `getConfiguredMapTileUrlTemplate()`, which the only product caller (online-map-picker.tsx) invokes per render and passes explicitly; the tests also pass explicit templates or null. No intent requirement needs the module-load snapshot or the default-parameter fallback, and the snapshot could silently diverge from a fresh read in any context where the module is loaded before the environment is final (e.g. Jest module reuse across files with different env). Smallest remedy: remove the `configuredMapTileUrlTemplate` export and the default parameter, making `tileUrlTemplate` a required argument of `getMapTiles`. This is a simplification/removal question, not an auto-fix refactor, so it needs author confirmation.
